title: TaskHive
description: A team-based task-management platform with a Django REST backend and React frontend.
results: Backend unit and integration tests accompany the implementation.
The repository’s Locust smoke profile targets the locally running Docker stack.
status: Runs locally · Public demo in progress
context: Team-based task management needs more than task CRUD: access must stay scoped to the team, permissions need consistent enforcement, and background work should not dominate request handling.
contribution: Built the Django REST backend and React/TypeScript frontend, including team-scoped permissions, backend tests, and a Docker-based local environment.

architecture.summary: A modular Django backend groups users, teams, projects, and tasks into domains. PostgreSQL stores application data; Redis and Celery support background processing.

components.name: Product interface
components.detail: React/TypeScript frontend and Django REST API.

components.name: Domain & data
components.detail: Domain modules, explicit services, and PostgreSQL.

components.name: Background work
components.detail: Redis and Celery workers alongside the API.

decisions.title: Keep domain rules explicit
decisions.description: The backend uses domain modules and service functions to separate business behavior from request serialization. This keeps the application in one codebase while giving its responsibilities clear boundaries.

decisions.title: Scope access to the team
decisions.description: Roles and permissions apply within a team context. The API must verify access to the relevant team rather than treating authentication alone as authorization.

decisions.title: Test behavior before claiming performance
decisions.description: Unit and integration tests support the permission and domain behavior. Locust smoke tests exercise the local system, but do not establish production capacity or a service-level guarantee.

limitations: Operational locally; a public online demo is still in progress. Test coverage describes backend tests. Local latency and error-rate observations are not presented as production benchmarks.
resourceNote: Explore the backend repository and its local setup instructions. The frontend is part of the project described in the professional profile.
